videos.title: What is MCP (Model Context Protocol)? | Explained for Absolute Beginners
videos.description:
🚀 What is MCP (Model Context Protocol)? | Explained for Absolute Beginners

Curious about MCP (Model Context Protocol) and why everyone in the AI world is talking about it?

In this beginner-friendly tutorial, you'll learn what MCP is, why it matters, and how it helps AI models and AI agents securely connect with external tools, databases, APIs, applications, and real-world data sources.

As Generative AI and AI Agents become more popular, MCP is emerging as a standard way to enable AI systems to interact with tools and services without requiring custom integrations for every application.

videos.title: AWS Generative AI for Beginners | Amazon Bedrock & Amazon Q Explained
videos.description:
🚀 AWS Generative AI for Beginners | Amazon Bedrock & Amazon Q Explained

Want to learn Generative AI on AWS but don't know where to start?

In this beginner-friendly AWS Generative AI tutorial, you'll learn the fundamentals of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Foundation Models (FMs), and the key AWS GenAI services including Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Q.

We'll explore Amazon Bedrock, review available foundation models, build a serverless Generative AI application, make API calls to Bedrock, and see how Amazon Q Developer can help developers write, explain, review, and debug code faster.

Whether you're a developer, cloud engineer, solution architect, student, or AI enthusiast, this video will give you a solid understanding of the AWS Generative AI ecosystem.

📌 In This Video

✅ What is Generative AI?
✅ Benefits of Generative AI
✅ Foundation Models (FM) vs Large Language Models (LLM)
✅ What is Amazon Bedrock?
✅ Amazon Bedrock Console Walkthrough
✅ Foundation Models Available
